text: Cinemart Drive, built in 1985, is a collector road located north of Highway 401 and runs westerly from Morningside Avenue to Milner Avenue and primarily serves the Smart Centres' commercial shopping mall located on the north side of Cinemart Drive. There is a portion of Cinemart Drive that falls within the Ontario Ministry of Transportation's right-of-way between Morningside Avenue and approximately 220 metres west thereof which will continue to be retained by the Ministry (See Appendix 1 Map), while the remaining portion of Cinemart Drive continues to be under the jurisdiction of the City of Toronto. The purpose of this report is to seek authorization for the execution of an agreement between the City of Toronto and Her Majesty the Queen in right of the Province of Ontario, represented by the Minister of Transportation for the Province of Ontario to formalize and clarify both parties'…

City Council on February 2 and 3, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the General Manager, Transportation Services to negotiate, enter into, and execute an agreement with Her Majesty the Queen in right of the Province of Ontario, represented by the Minister of Transportation for the Province of Ontario, generally in accordance with the Agreement Terms listed on page 3 of the report (December 20, 2021) from the General Manager, Transportation Services, and on such other terms and conditions satisfactory to the General Manager, Transportation Services, and in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor.
